OP15.name: OP15-EB04
OP15.note: The English product holds 30 EB04 cards beside OP15's own (Japan's EB-04 split between OP14 and OP15); they share the slots by base rarity. Bandai publishes no slot layout or pull rates: the layout and weights are community estimates, as the main sets OP-13 to OP-17 share them (Hunter, 15 October 2026). About 6.5 SRs, 3 Leaders and 0.6 SECs a box of 24.

slots.note: The rare slot. A parallel here (about 1 a box) can be an SR or a Leader, which plays as its base card.
The R-or-better slot: about 6 SRs, 3 Leaders and 0.6 SECs a box of 24.

specials.note: Special art printings, about 2 a case of 12 boxes, in place of the rare slot; each plays as its base card.
Treasure Rare printings, about 1 a case, in place of the rare slot; each plays as its base card.
